subject: Appointment of the Chairperson of the Board of Trustees of the Canadian Museum of History
precis: Approval of the appointment by the Minister of Canadian Heritage of Graham Carr of Montréal, Quebec, to be Chairperson of the Board of Trustees of the Canadian Museum of History, to hold office during pleasure for a term of four years, in the place of Carole C.
